cds.title: The University of Texas at Tyler Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF)

ipeds.title: IPEDS College Navigator (profile, fall 2024 admissions, 2024-25 expenses)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (fall 2025 entering class): men 1,992 + women 3,484 applied (5,476); admitted 5,194; enrolled 1,541; the residency rows (in-state / out-of-state / international) add up to the totals. International first-years: 34 applied, 33 admitted (97%), 12 enrolled. No early decision or early action; rolling notification. The Common Data Set PDF text lost its checkbox marks, so the admission-factor importance ratings and the test-policy box could not be read, and admission factors are not shown. GPA: the average is 3.24 (77.26% reporting); the 'all enrolled students' distribution has 6.43% below 1.0, which makes the 4.0 to 1.0 bands add up to only 93.6%, so the distribution is left out rather than shown incomplete (bands: 4.0 3.41%, 3.75-3.99 31.27%, 3.50-3.74 25.71%, 3.25-3.49 17.22%, 3.00-3.24 10.08%, 2.50-2.99 5.71%, 2.0-2.49 0.16%, 1.0-1.99 0.00%). Undergraduate enrollment is 8,219 and the nonresident count is 234 (the 'Total Undergraduates' figures, fall 2025). The Common Data Set carries 2024-2025 page headers on a 2025-2026 collection.

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs from the Common Data Set, as printed under the 2026-2027 heading: in-state tuition $7,232, nonresident tuition $22,680 (about $756/credit hour x 30), required fees $2,504, on-campus food and housing $13,756 (housing $9,074 + meal plan $4,684). Its estimates for residents: books $2,920, transportation $1,424, other $1,714 (the other costs shown combine transportation and other). UT Tyler publishes no separate international tuition rate on the pages checked, so international tuition is shown as the nonresident rate
